messages:
Nina: Quick sync: HealthCo wants a POC packet. They asked for: CAIQ, affirmation on SCCs + DPA, explicit DSAR deletion steps for hosted POC, and pricing for a 60-day dedicated trial. Any takers?

Omar: I can take the CAIQ. They use CSA format. Note: encryption key controls on hosted are 'partial' (no customer HSM). I’ll note scope for dedicated.

Priya: For DSARs we currently have 7 business days turnaround for data access requests and 10 business days for deletion where ops run the invalidate flow. For POC we can commit to 10 days.

Legal-bot: DPA + SCC acceptance confirmed. DPA template updated. Subprocessor appendix will be included.

platform-ops: Ops notes: to run ephemeral mode set LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=0 and set EPHEMERAL_MODE=true. Cache invalidation endpoint: POST /admin/tenants/{tenant}/invalidate-cache. Purge + confirmation within 5-7 business days. Curl example attached.

Nina: Good. Action: Omar -> CAIQ + notes; Priya -> DSAR language + timeline; platform-ops -> curl + runbook snippet; Legal-bot -> DPA + subprocessor list. I’ll compile and send.

Omar: Will also include links to SOC2 and latest pen-test report.

Priya: Reminder: fine-tuning artifacts are per-tenant. Deletion requires both cache invalidate and model artifact purge where applicable.

Nina: Perfect. Ship it tomorrow morning.
